Usage: astryx init [options]

Initialize the design system in your project

Options:
  --features <list>            Comma-separated features: agents (agent docs), theme (writes theme.template.ts), template (prints the page-building commands; writes no file). An unknown feature exits 1 with ERR_UNKNOWN_FEATURE. Refused with --all or --remove-agents
  --all                        Install all features (agents, theme, template); refused with --features. Prints their guidance instead of the getting-started steps
  --remove-agents              Remove the managed block from AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules, .hermes.md and HERMES.md, at the project root (where init writes them) and in this folder (deleting AGENTS.md or .claude/CLAUDE.md when only init's heading is left, and GEMINI.md when nothing is left) and do nothing else. Below the project root, a project-root agent file whose block resolves outside the project is left as it is, with a note. --features, --all, --agent and --agent-docs-path are refused; a file written with --agent-docs-path keeps its block
  --user                       Write or refresh the computer-level agent text instead of setting up the folder: one skill file, ~/.agents/skills/astryx/SKILL.md, which most coding agents read, linked into the skill folders of agents that read only their own (~/.claude/skills always; Kiro, Windsurf, Letta, Xcode's coding assistant, and ~/.config/agents/skills when that folder exists): a folder symlink with a relative target, a junction on Windows, or a copy where neither can be made. Continue, whose scanner skips links, gets a managed copy, refreshed with the file. It tells agents anywhere on the computer that Astryx is there, when it is relevant, and to start with `astryx search`. Records the links it made in astryx/settings.json in the per-user configuration folder, so removal removes exactly those; the CLI installed for the computer refreshes the file in the background after each upgrade. Works in any folder. A file without the Astryx markers, one edited since Astryx wrote it, or a symlink, is kept as it is, and so is anything at a link target that Astryx did not create. Warns, and still writes, when no `astryx` command on the computer runs the Astryx CLI. With --remove-agents it removes the file, the links, and the copy instead and records that the text is turned off. --features, --all, --agent and --agent-docs-path are refused
  --agent <tool>               Target AI tool for agent docs: claude (CLAUDE.md or .claude/CLAUDE.md, else creates .claude/CLAUDE.md), cursor (.cursorrules if present, else AGENTS.md), codex and muse (AGENTS.md), hermes (.hermes.md or HERMES.md if present, else AGENTS.md), all (every existing agent doc except GEMINI.md, which keeps its one-line import of AGENTS.md, else AGENTS.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md). With claude and all, when CLAUDE.md gets the block, .claude/CLAUDE.md gets none and a block already there is removed, unless the project ignores CLAUDE.md: then a .claude/CLAUDE.md the project commits gets a copy too, with claude and all alike. An unknown tool exits 1 with ERR_UNKNOWN_AGENT. Used only when agent docs are installed (the default, --all, or --features agents); --agent-docs-path takes precedence.
  --agent-docs-path <path...>  Explicit file path(s) for agent docs, inside the project; takes precedence over --agent. If any path is outside the project, no agent docs are written and the command exits 1. A path in the home folder itself, or in a settings folder in it outside a project (such as ~/.claude or ~/.claude/hooks), is refused with a note (exit 0), and nothing is written. Used only when agent docs are installed
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success, including agent docs left unwritten in five soft cases, each reported as docsError with one note: running in the home folder, or in a settings folder in it outside a project; a GEMINI.md that resolves outside the project; when init runs below the project root, a project-root agent file that resolves outside the project; the project's Claude Code file (root CLAUDE.md, or .claude/CLAUDE.md when there is no root one) when it resolves outside the project and is a block-less import of an existing AGENTS.md, which 0.7.1 left alone; and a .claude/CLAUDE.md that resolves outside the project and that 0.7.1 did not write: beside a CLAUDE.md the project ignores, the one --agent claude adds or a block-less import of an existing AGENTS.md; with --agent claude beside a CLAUDE.md, one whose block it would remove
  1  an unknown --agent (ERR_UNKNOWN_AGENT) or feature, an --agent-docs-path outside the project, --remove-agents combined with install options, --user combined with --features, --all, --agent or --agent-docs-path, or --all with --features (ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT); or, when init runs at the project root, an agent file 0.7.1 also wrote there that resolves outside the project (ERR_PATH_TRAVERSAL, docsError path-safety, nothing written)

Examples:
  # Default setup
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init
  # All features, no prompts
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init --all
  # Machine-readable receipt
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init --json
  # Agent text for the whole computer
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init --user
  # Remove the computer-level agent text and turn it off
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init --user --remove-agents

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/init
